items.claim: Palette lab, Theme editor and Theme prefs links get a 404 in dev because the theme editor's vite base needs a trailing slash
`otherPrefValue` returns default + 1, above a number leaf's max, when the default is the max and there is no min; a one-option enum throws a TypeError
`prefsRoundTrip` leaves the first store open when `flush` fails or a `set` throws
`parsePackageRoute` rejects a trailing slash (`pkg/geom/`), and `pkg/geom/overview/x` parses with a `rest` that `packageRoute` then drops
The Releases fallback counts Internal entries toward `FALLBACK_MIN_ENTRIES` but never shows them
The built forge lab link `/weasel/docs/ui/forge` had no trailing slash, though forge's built base is `/weasel/docs/ui/forge/`
items.note: (same commit as the first finding). The new test runs only in dev mode, so this built-mode change was checked by reading the code.
